purpose: persistent structural memory for the Atom causal architecture

upstream.policy: fetch-only reference with disabled push URL

fork.new_role: typed causal glyph persistence, structural resonance, and prediction-driven motif conductance

causal_glyph.motif_identity: content address of glyph identity, structural role, and value
causal_glyph.catalog: hash-bound Primitive Forge graph selected through a causal Atom DB root

retrieval.method: exact graph-motif resonance with role-specific activation and durable conductance

learning.input: expected versus selected glyph from an observed prediction
learning.correct_prediction: strengthen every matched motif on the selected expected glyph
learning.wrong_prediction: weaken matched motifs on the selected glyph and strengthen matched motifs on the expected glyph
learning.persistence: one atomic feedback cell with exact event and motif provenance
learning.query_policy: queries open the store read-only and never change durable state
